title: Dual reflection groups for three-dimensional Artin--Schelter regular algebras
summary: By definition, a dual reflection group is a finite group which grades an Artin--Schelter regular algebra $A$ such that the identity component $A_e$ is again regular. In this paper, we completely classify the nonabelian dual reflection groups for regular algebras of dimension $3$: we first classify all possible nonabelian gradings which refine the natural $\mathbb{N}$-grading of the algebra, and then determine which of these gradings yield dual reflection groups.
